service_boundary: Represents the DeepSeek Open Platform API, not the DeepSeek chat product, downloadable model weights, or DeepSeek models hosted by third parties.
regional_controls: The reviewed public documentation exposes a global API base URL and does not establish customer-selected inference regions.
retention_controls: The platform terms and privacy materials govern service data; the reviewed technical docs document request isolation but do not establish a universal Zero Data Retention option.
routing: Customers select DeepSeek-operated model endpoints; compatible interfaces do not make the service a router.
customization: The reviewed public direct API does not document customer-imported weights or dedicated deployments.
strengths: Direct first-party access with widely used compatible API conventions.
Technical documentation identifies model versions, limits, and isolation behavior.
tradeoffs: Public regional and retention controls are less explicit than major cloud platforms.
The direct service is limited to DeepSeek model families.
